title: Glowing Coals
description: A bed of embers breathing in the dark — rounded charcoal lumps and angular charred-wood chunks packed together, each shaded with a directional highlight and shadow so it reads as a 3D lump rather than a flat disc, with molten-orange heat glowing up through the cracks. Incoming airflow sweeps a bright ripple of pooled oxygen across the bed in the direction you set, flaring embers hotter as it passes; a bank of pale grey-white ash rises along the bottom where the coals sit, catching a little ember glow at its crest. Blow on it (move the pointer) to fan a patch hotter; beats gust the whole bed alive and lift the odd spark. Heat, airflow amount and direction, crust, cracks, wood-chunk and ash amount, coal size and palette are live and mappable.
